annotations.title: Social security (ZUS) of a sole proprietor in Poland

description: Monthly social security contributions (ZUS: pension, disability, sickness, accident, Labour Fund) of a sole proprietor (JDG) in Poland under each scheme: start relief (ulga na start), preferential ZUS and full ZUS, with the contribution base. The health contribution depends on the tax form and income; use calc_net_income with form b2b for it.
